sourceNotes: 菜单栏网速旁可选显示公网 IP 归属地的国旗或地区文字，复用网络详情的查询结果，不增加网络请求
进程页新增系统活动监视器入口
进程管理改为默认关闭的可选功能，可在通用设置中按需开启
“AI 用量与额度”统一简化为“AI 用量”，同步多语言名称与说明
优化卸载确认弹窗的按钮、文案和长应用名排版，明确所选项目与废纸篓恢复方式
修复在线更新安装后可能无法自动启动的问题
修复卸载前退出菜单栏应用后，“正在运行”提示及卸载按钮未及时刷新的问题

en: Optionally show the public IP country flag or region beside menu bar network speeds, reusing existing results without extra requests
Add a shortcut to Activity Monitor on the Processes page; when the built-in process feature is disabled, the process keyboard shortcut opens Activity Monitor
Make process management optional and disabled by default; enable it in General settings. Per-app usage remains available on other monitoring pages
Rename “AI Usage and Quotas” to “AI Usage” across all languages
Improve uninstall confirmation buttons, wording, and long app names; clarify selected items and Trash recovery
Fix automatic relaunch after installing an update; if the app does not relaunch after the first upgrade from an older version, open it manually once
Fix delayed refresh of running status and the uninstall button after quitting menu bar apps
